# Ayrshare

Ayrshare provides a Social Media API that enables developers to programmatically manage and automate social media posts, analytics, and interactions across multiple platforms.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ayrshare/.

## Actions

- **Delete a previously published Ayrshare post**: Delete an ayrshare post.
- **Create Auto Schedule**: Create a new auto-post schedule with specified times and optional weekday filters.
- **Get Post History** (read-only): Retrieve ayrshare post history with metrics.
- **Set Auto Schedule**: Set up an auto-post schedule with specified times and optional weekday filters.
